verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review platform with a CLI and an MCP server that coding agents can connect to, so live-app debugging from a coding assistant is a plausible axis. However, the evidence only covers reviewing diffs, local uncommitted changes, PR findings and codebase scans. Nothing shows attaching to, inspecting, or debugging a running web application.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug a live running web application directly from my coding assistant
